྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ kha zhe gnyis ka kha khar nyin rgyun du song bas//kha sang de ring sems la bdag po zhig rgyobs dngaka/rang mthong che bas 'gyur med nga rgyal la phyogs nas//rang las gzhan skyon chung yang lhun po ru 'khrul ba'i//rang sems smyon pa'i ngang tshul gsal rjen la ston gyin//rang bstod ri bong rwa yi kha dog de yogleng //ra sha mi 'phrod zer gyin lug sha la rngam ste//la lung 'phrang na 'dzem med grong chog 'bar dmigs pa//sha la rngam pa'i ri kha'i a pho dang mtshungs pas/sa dang lam gyi yon tan nam zhig tu 'byor ram//chos kyi phyir du dgon par 'ong na yang //nor gyi don du grong la 'khyams pa mtshangaka/60

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/ ྾ 'khor ba zer gyin nges 'byung skyes khul gyis//'bul ba bsam nas rmi lam rmis pa mtshang //mi rtag zer nas gnas lugs rtogs khul gyis//mi 'dang bsam nas ser snar phyogs pa mtshang //nam yang srog gcod mi rung zer gyin du//tshon po'i sha la rngam pa shin tu mtshangaka/thar ba 'dod na chung nas dge ba sgrubs|dkon mchog gsum por snying nas blo rton ces//bzang dang yon tan med pa'i chos 'dzin khyos//chos rje bla ma'i zhal nas ma thos sam/kha chung dbang chung nang gi sems chung khyod//ya chung ma chung bar na smug chung zhig/61

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ bsdus chung grogs chung gras su gnyom chung ngangaka/blo chung klad chung nang la mun chung 'thibs/thos chung mthong chung sel phyir shes chung khyos/na chung grogs chung rnams la rtsod chung byas//dgon chung rgyugs chung len dus mi chung khyo'i/ya chung snying chung lding ba'i sgra chung khyab// dpe chung yig chung gshar ma'i nag chung rer//mig chung g.yo chung byas nas brkus chung byas//grogs chung 'dzum chung mngon gyin mdzub chung bstan//dman chung rna chung gnyis la tsha chung rgyas//chos med srid med chos 'dzin rgya mtsho khyos//dgos med 'dang log ma mang zhu ba byed//62

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ mi 'chi'i phyogs 'dzin don kun rgud pa'i 'phul//'chi ba dran pa phun tshogs bye ba'i sgo/des na 'chi ba thun re bsgom par bya//nges par 'chi ste ma shi lus pa med|rang lus 'dus byas tshe ni skad cig 'dzad//yin gcig min gnyis 'chi ba bsgom par bya//nam 'chi nges pa rang la ma mchis pas//tshe la nges med lus la snying bo med//'chi rkyen mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gzhir bcangs nas//yin gcig min gnyis 'chi ba dran par bya//'chi tshe chos min gang gis mi phan te//gnyen bshes zas nor mang yang phan mi thogs//63

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ rang lus yin yang gang yang mi sman pas//yin gcig min gnyis 'chi ba dran par bya//'chi ba dran tsam gyis kyang ga la chog/'chi ba thag chod dam chos nges par sgrubs//nam 'chi cha med da nas sgrub par 'tshal//'phags pa chos yin dam chos kho nar brtson//khyim pa'i las la snying bo ma mchis te//rnam snang bye ba'i grong khyer thang yangs por//g.yo sgyu sna tshogs thabs kyi char chu yis//bsam yas khe bzang myu gu skyong la brel//'brog pa'i yul na kla klor sbrul ba rnams//'khor bar sred pa'i dbyug gu mngon thogs nas//64

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/ ྾ chos brgyad rnga bo brdung la gtan phyogs pas//mkhas pa'i mdun sar skyo ba'i zlos gar 'chams/— rong sar lkugs pa'i rnam thar skyong mkhan tshos//mtho la blo yis ma gzhol rmongs pas brgyalakudama' bar khengs pas ma bzod dregs pas myos//chos srid gang yang ma 'khyongs rang skal 'chor//sgo na zungs zad khye'us zug skad 'byin/nang na bu dang chung mas sdug yus bstar/bar du rang sems skya mos mun par 'thams/tha mar ci yang ma 'grub lnga lam bzhud/ bco lnga'i na tshod me tog gsar ba'i dus/dgos med grogs kyi bung bas rang nyid bcom//65

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ phan bde'i bde gshegs snying bo'i ge sar bcud//yod med cha la rmongs blo'i 'dab ma rnyid//dran pa'i gzhu mo nang du bdungs na yang /phrag dog tshig gi mda' mo phyir phyogs pas//mkho med dgra bo'i 'ben la phog dang lhan//dug gsum sa rdos rnam dkar mde'u zad//dkar dkar skra los spyi gtsug ma bcings pa'i//so dkar gzhon pa'i dus su ma brtson na//rnam dkar chos zhes sang la bskyur ba ni//gangs dkar nyi mas bzhu dang khyad mi 'dug/chos srid gang la 'jug ba'i snga rol du//yang dag bsam blo'i rtsa ba tshugs pa la//66

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ ja'i smyod stangs/a mdo'i yul gyi chab rom bkra shis dar thang ni//a bo nga yi lte khrag pho sa'i sa cha yin//ha cang chung dus sems la 'char sgo ci yang med//ha lam mi tshe phyed ka don med rtsed 'jor g.yengs//sa phyogs gcig pa'i grogs dang spun mched pha ma la//sha tsha med pa'i bu nga nga rgyal dregs pas brgyagalwa ba gang mdzes du chang phyir la pha yang bslus/rwa ltar mkhregs pa'i sems rgyud dbang gis mar yang 'khogaya gi dgon gyi tshogs la zhugs pa'i nyin mo nas/'a 'ur gzhung lugs rtsod pa'i tshul 'dir don med snyam/68

྾dran pa'i zin tho/྾ za ma 'gyed skalasbyin dang grong chog bslebs pa'i tshe//zhwa zlag gyon pa'i gral na ngang gis rlom sems shig/wa ltar nam rgyun g.yo sgyus gzan la phyogs pa'i nga //dza ya'i shākya'i bstan pa'i bstan 'dzin yin khul gyis//tsha grang spyad de ru sde'i 'phrang na dkor dzee'athams/tsa ri sogs su gnas mjal 'gro ba'i srol la brdzus//ma gi grong na slob grwar 'grims dus bdag gi sems//ba gam— can gyi slob khang dag las slob byol brel//pha ma'i re ba ci yang mi bsam bag med kyisakapa pha a mes rig gzhung thams cad mkho med pasams//na mnyam khag cig pra tshag nga 'drar 'akrogs pa yis//da lta khrims dang 'gal ba'i las la zhugs pa mang //69

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ tha ma kha yi ring thung brtsad de 'thab 'dzing byas//tā rin rnams dang dpa' bo'i drung na zhum zhum chas//nya nyog tshig gis 'dod gtam smras pa thengs gcig min//ja chang chags bror rol ba'i 'gro song nyung nyung min//cha lugs gzhan du 'gyur bas rang rigs srol yang shor//ca co'i smyon pa'i gtam gyis mchog gsum med par smras//nga 'drar skya ser gang gis smod kyang khrigs se ste//ga ler dus rabs phreng bar bsags pa'i yang mes nor//kha nas mkho med smra ba rang nyid smyos pa'i rtags//ka ba rgyang du bor tshe gdung lcam mi ltung ci//70

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ ngagle/ lko / // /gyi tsho /ri / // /lhosgyu 1 / don dam thar ba'i snying bo gang yin ma nges kyang //da lta'i bar du mgo bo krog krog phyogs sar brgyugs//da ni rang gis rang la phan pa'i bsam blo yis//rang mtshang 'byin pa'i tshogs gsum ri mor 'god par bya//ka ra sil tog zas kyi sder kha la rngam ste/kha ton mi byed sems yan grogs po ru sbran nas//ga sa gang gi zas nor 'bul grangs kyis phyug pa//nga 'dra'i bsod nams can las sus reg ces lab song //ca co'i glen gtam 'di rigs sems gting nas bor tekucha lugs chos mthun byed paṭwāṃ dge sbyor ni phar zhog//

྾dran pa'i zin tho/smo ja slong zas slong mkhan la snang mig gis bgrad kyin//nya nyog 'di tsho zer nas gang 'dod kyis gshes sokatā ki ta yi mig shel rdzig nyams kyis btags te/tha mag chang la zhen pa'i zur mig cig g.yo bzhin//da dung tshul min 'dod pa'i bstan bcos la phyogs te//na chung mdzes ma zhig gi 'dzum bag la chags song ku pā li'i zhabs bro 'khrab sa'i 'dod khang du skyod pa/pha rol yon bdag 'ga' yis mngon sum du mthong yang //ba ber rang snang chang gis myos pa ltar gyur nas/ma rabs bstan dgra'i las la bsam bzhin du zhugs songakatsa ge tsig ge rung zhes 'dul khrims la 'gal nas//tsha tshod a rag da lta'i bza' btung yin zer gyin//dza ya'i bstan bcos nga 'dra'i bslab gzhi min snyam rsāwaler rang mtshang gzhan pa'i mthong lam du gtad byung|72

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ zhwa dang lwa ba sogs kyis grong tshugs shig btod de//za zing khrom pa'i srang la nyin rgyun du rgyug cing /'a 'ur tshul min gtam la dga' spro yis gzhol ba//ya mtshan chos dang bstun na bzhad gad las mi 'dug/ra ba 'di nanyin dkar bstan 'dzin gyi gzugs brnyan//la lung gzhan du mtshan mo'i chom rkun gyi rgyal bo//sha chang chags pa'i las la hab thob rang byed pa//sa cha 'di na je mang je mang las mi 'dug/ha cang thal ba'i snang tshul 'di dag la bsams na//a tsi ban chung nga 'dras dogs gzon rang 'cha' dgos//ha cang smod pa'i gtam gyis skyon mtshang 'ga' brjod pa//a le glen chung nga yi gshis ka la mched yod/ka dag chos don zab mo snying ga ru med kyangakakha bshad mo lung gtam gyis gzhan mgonyid skor bar/73

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ ga sa gang gi dran dbang rgyal bo tshos dpyad na//nga ro tsam las don snying gang ci yang mi 'dug/ca re zol gyis 'gro rnams 'dren pa ru brdzus nas//cha rgyus yod med rim kro 'gan khur du blangs te//ja dang nor la chags pa'i sems byung gi ched du//nya mo mtsho na 'khyug bzhin grong sde la brel song //tā len g.yas su bskyur nas rdzig nyams dang bcas te//tha mal 'khor ba zer gyin chos bshad re rgyag bzhin//da lta'i mi rnams bsod nams dman pa la zer gyin//na ning da lo'i rang gi yong sgo la bsam songaka/pa sangs mdangs la 'phya ba'i lhag bsam ni phar zhog/pha rol yon bdag slu ba'i g.yo thabs la phyogs pa//ba glang spyod las grub rtags gzhan med pa mthong bar//ma lus mkhas dgu'i rang lugs gcig mthun du bzhed song /74

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ tsa ri'i gnas su chos byed grub thob tu brdzus nas//tsha grangadaka' thub nyin 'gar spyad pa yi rjes su//dza ya'i chos 'di nga 'dras mi 'ongs rang bsam gyin / /wa mo'i thabs kyis dkor nor 'tshol ba la phyogs song kuzhwa ser dmar nag kha dog phyogs ris la brgyugs te//za 'thung bya byed bar nas phan tshun la snang ba'i//'a cag 'ga' zhig su yi bstan 'dzin yin bsams tshe//ya mtshan ltad mo tsam las rgyu mtshan gzhan ma mthong //ra lug nor gyi gshis la snga mo nas goms shing //la lung 'phrang na nyi ma chod thabs tsam byed kyin//sha khrag rkang min zas gzhan spyod 'dod med zer nas//sa dang lam gyi yon tan rtsa ba nas bor song //ha ha de ring lha bshos legs po zhig bzos song // he he de ring mchod 'go btsan po zhig 'khyongs song //75

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ thol byung khag gcigadagon gsar gyi khor yug la sbyar nas bris pa/rgyab na lo rgyus rtsom pa'i rdza ri zhig/mdun sar rnam thar skyong ba'i sgrub phug cig/bar du gdan rabs 'chol ba'i dgon sde zhig/'di gsum tshangs pa'i bkod sgrig yin nam ci//byang na chal chil g.yo ba'i mtsho mo zhig/lho ru lhung lhung 'bab pa'i chu klung zhig/bar na 'jab rgol che ba'i chu mdzod cig/'di gsum tshangs ba'i bkod sgrig yin nam ci//shar na nor lug 'tsho sa'i spang thang zhig/nub tu gnam gru 'bebs sa'i ar thang zhig/bar la lo tog 'debs sa'i sa thang zhig/'di gsum tshangs ba'i bkod sgrig yin nam ci// 77

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ shar lho'i mtshams su glog gi 'byung khungs shig/nub byang bar du chu yi 'byung khungs shig/re re rjes na khral gyi 'byung khungs re//'di gsum tshangs pa'i bkod sgrig yin nam ci//lho nub mtshams su 'brug mo'i thab ka zhig/byang shar bar na ge sar ba rdo zhig/de gnyis sbrel ba'i dpa' po'i sgrung ring zhig/'di gsum tshangs pa'i bkod sgrig yin nam ci//pha rol gan na lha khang grags chen zhig/tshu rol sa na sngags khang ming chen zhig/de gnyis bar na dgon pa don chen zhig/'di gsum tshangs pa'i bkod sgrig yin nam ci//lha khang de na dkor gnyer rgyu can zhig/sngags khang de na grub thob ngo chen zhig/78

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/ ྾ dgon pa de na mkhas pa dbang chen zhig/'di gsum tshangs pa'i bkod sgrig yin nam ci//mchod stegs steng na 'arnyan 'phrin 'phrul chas shig/mdun cog steng du sgra sdud 'khor lo zhig/gzan sham bar na lag khyer kha par zhig/'di gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa yin nam ci//ya gi'i gong na mchod 'go btsan po zhig/ma gi'i zhol na mchod g.yog rang rgyal zhig/de gnyis bar btsun pa dbang chen zhig/'di gsum ston pa'i rjes 'jug yin nam ci//gral gyi mgo na a khu lab rkyal zhig/gral gyi mtha' ru btsun chung pra tshag cig/gral gyi sked na ban de gnyid rkyal zhig/'di gsum ston pa'i rjes 'jug yin nam ci//79

ci ྾dranapa'izin tho/྾ skyabs gsum mtshan gzhi blo la ma 'drong zhingakakha dog dkar dmar sgro 'dog mchod kyangaka'adi phyi'i lam sna 'dren par mi thogs pa/// 'di gsum rgyal sras grub rtags yin nam ci//sbyin bdag tshang la dad pa brtan po zhig/mdun cog steng na 'bul ba mod po zhig/a mchod sems la 'char gzhi chen po zhiga'adi gsum ston pa'i bstan dang mthun nam ci/phyi nang ma nges phyogs ris lam la 'thams//don gyi khur bo u tshugs dbyangs la bkyags//rang gzhan lhan du rgud pa'i cho 'phrul te/'di ni rgyal ba'i bstan la mkho 'am cikutshig gi sbyor ba'i phrad la mthong chung 'dzin/don gyi snying bo'i ro la lce dbang bor//yid kyi dmigs pa rmongs pa'i smag tu 'khyams//'di yang rgyal bstan 'phe~X 0ba'i rtags sam ci//

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ nor zhen gyis brdzis pa'i col gtam/ka kha sum rtags la sogs lto rgyab la mi mkho//kha dog dkar dmar rtsod pa dgos med kyi las bcol//ga sa gang du rim gro'i 'bul grangs kyis rgyal na//nga tsho chos pa yin pa'i khyad chos shig min nam//ca co'i ngag gis chos grwa rtsod pa de g.yugs zhog/cha bzhi shugs kyis thon dang yong sgo ni der che//ja sogs 'bul grangs mod na snang ba yang de skyid//nya nyog po ti mang po'i gnas lugs des ci byed//ta len nang la brdzangs pa'i 'bab sgo de bsams na/tha mar grwa chas gyon min the tshom zhig skyes kyangaka/81

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ da ni nor lha ma bsgrubs gter bdag ṭubyung ba/na med rga med a khu nga 'dra tsho min nam//pa sangs ltar dkar byang sems rang rgyud du med na//pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa tshe gcig gis mi 'khyongs//ba 'bri 'ga' re gsos te 'o ja re 'thung bzhin//‘‘ma bzang rgod bro’’ zer gyin skyid po rang 'cha' ya/tsa rir gnas skor 'grims pa'i mjal ba tshor bltas na//tshwa mtsho g.yas g.yon 'grim pa'i grong chog pa skyid ang //dza ya'i gsung rab klog sbyor kha'i nang gi rlangs pa|wa ler mthong ba rang gi 'byor phyug gi kha snon//zha sgyug kha lo sgyur ba'i mkhas pa zhig min yang //za 'thung las ka'i bar na mkhan po zhig blangs yod//82

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ 'a 'ur gtam gleng khrod du mgur dbyangs shig 'then gyin//ya rabs spyod par brdzus nas mi tshe 'di skyel ya//rwa co ri bong mgo na yod med sogs brtsad nas//la las don med ngal ba phrag steng du len pa//sha tsha che ba'i a khu med pa yi rtags las//sa lam 'thob pa'i rgyu cha 'tshol pa ni ma red//ha ha 'di 'dra'i gtam la rgod kha rang 'chor 'ongaka/a rogs 'di tsho rje btsun su tshang gi rang lugs//ha ne hon ne'i chos 'dzin rgya bo de'i min na//a mdo'i phyogs na lta ngan 'di 'dra zhig sur yod//83

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ dri ba/bcu drug sems pa mdza' glu'i rta la phyogs//nyer drug lang tsho dga' ma'i thugs la bstun//sum cu'i na tshod 'gyod pas snying la gtses//'di gsum mi yi 'gro lugs yin nam ci// a mas gtad pa'i phye rtsam bsang la phud//a phas bgos pa'i nor rnams khral la 'jal//rang lag stong bar g.yugs te phyogs sar 'khyams//'di gsum 'jig rten 'gro lugs yin nam ci//lus kyi phung bo sgrub phug nang du bcugs//ngag gi sbyor bas gzhung tshig shugs kyis gyer//84

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ yid kyi dran pas su yis skyob par re//'di gsum chos pa'i 'gro lugs yin nam ci//gyes pa'i mdza' mos gdung ba skyes su phulakusdug pa'i bu yi mgo bo sa la dpyangs//phan tshun dgod sgra ma thos lo 'ga' phyin//'di gsum gshin rjes bzhag pa'i khral lam ci//steng gi lha zhes yod par thos na yangaka'og gi klu la 'dri sa ma rnyed pas//mi dang mi yi bar la the tshom zhig/'di gsum su la thebs pa'i gyong gud yin//85

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/ ྾ lha la dga' ste gsol ba rgyun mar btabs/klu la skrag ste gang sar spo ma phod//'di ltar tshe yi phyed ka rdzogs dgos pa//gshin rje chos kyi rgyal bo'i bka' 'am ci/rang la rang dang 'tshams pa'i lam bu zhig/gzhan la gzhan dang mthun pa'i stegs bu zhig/de gnyis bar na rtsod pa'i yi ka zhig/'di yang tshangs pa'i las 'phro yin nam ci/86

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ mi kha'i sems khrel/a mas byin pa'i phye rtsam lha bsang la gtong bzhin//a phas bgos pa'i rgyu nor rgyal khral la 'jal gyin//a nu'i sems pa chos min srid min la phyogs te//a khu skya min ser min ngang tshul 'dir khrel byung kumadun la rnga rgan bzar ba'i sngags rgan zhes 'phya zhing //lag la dril rgan thogs 'i ban rgan zhes smod cing //blo la ham rgan bcangs ba'i dpon rgan zhes gshes pas//rtsod med 'tsho ba'i bde skyid gang yin la khrel byungaka/87

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/྾ la las la nye med ces mdzub ker gyis 'phya zhing //la las la lung nyul pa'i rmongs rgan zhes smod cing /la las la rgya med pa'i zhabs 'dren zhes sdigs shing //la las la rgya'i bdag po su yin la khrel byungaka/ma rig gnyis kyis bskyed pa'i dug gsum gyi phung bo//ma mthong rang sa srung ba'i klad med kyi rigs zhes//ma dag blo yis chos srid gang la yang dpyad kyang //ma 'chi bar la nges don rnyed tshod rang mi 'dug/88

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/ ྾ grwa rkyang gi mthong thosaphyugs las grwa tshang ya gi'i rtswa sar 'dur/khe las tshogs pa ma gi'i tshong rar rgyug/gla gtong ru khag phyogs sar grim rig rig/'chal gtam mkhan po shul na 'ur chil ler/bstan pa'i 'jug sgo gang yin cha ma 'tshal//ya gi'i dgong na char sha btsan po zhig/ma gi'i sde ru gro zhing skam po gnyis//de gnyis bar na dung sgra sam sum zhig/su la thebs pa'i gyong gud 'jigs po 'dis//mchod yon bar la mi mthun sbyor ba bslangs//89

྾ dran pa'i zin tho/ ྾ dra 'i 'char yan/skyid kyis myos pa'i sems pas ma bzod khams gsum rang la dbang na 'dod//sdug la lhung ba'i lus kyis ma lcogs tshor ba'i yul 'di stongs na snyam//skyid sdug rnam pa'i ngag gi dbyangs rta gdangs su gyer bar nam yang spro//bla ma'i gsung la dad pas phyogs tshe da lta nyid du 'tshang rgyar 'dod//mdza' mo'i tshig la snying nas chags pas chos srid gang la bro ba dben//bcos min sems kyi 'gyur ldog nyid la rang tshugs med tshe pham byed nyid//90
